questions.question: The candidate is allowed to have non-messy snacks inside the examination hall. DESIGN A HOLIDAY HOME AT MANIPAL Design a Holiday home in Manipal. Two sides abutting of the internal road faces a lake, the main road of $8m$ width abuts one of the shorter sides of the site. The site is located in the residential zone and it is fairly flat. Use the views and vistas properly in the design. The positioning of vegetation and blocks are left to choice of students. Proper landscaping and functional flow inside the building carry more weightage. Proper setbacks and coverage applicable. DESIGN BRIEF: Car Parking 1no. Sit out 10 sq. m Living 25 sq. m Kitchen 12 sq. m Dining 16 sq. m 1 Bed room (for couple and a kid) with 25 sq. m attached toilet Common Toilet 5 sq. m garden Remaining site area (AE 231) Page 1 of 2 DRAWING REQUIREMENTS: Site Plan Scale 1:200 Floor Plans Scale $1:10^{\wedge 0}$ Sections Scale $1:10^{\wedge 0}$ Elevations Scale $1:10^{\wedge 0}$ Views one view Details Conceptual Drawings SITE MARKS ALLOTED: Site Plan 20 Marks Floor Plans 30 Marks Sections 10 Marks Elevations 10 Marks Views 10 Marks Details 10 Marks Conceptual Drawings 10 Marks ••••• (AE 231) Page 2 of 2
